audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 rendered 'Volibear'/'Skill' while the why-lines beneath them explicitly say Ambessa wins those stages, and the packet chart agrees with the prose, not the sides.
audit.why: packet levelChart is Skill / Ambessa / Ambessa / Volibear / Volibear / Ambessa / Ambessa. The mirror audit flagged the same generator fault.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 5, 6 flipped to Ambessa as matched full/content pairs with ratings dropped to 4/10; rows 0, 3, 4 already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Repeating Dashes' is not an Ambessa ability, and Volibear's R was credited with sustain and attack speed in whys[4], spikes[1] and mid.
audit.why: Her abilities are Drakehound's Step, Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, Repudiation, Lacerate and Public Execution. Stormbringer gives bonus Health and a tower disable — attack speed belongs to The Relentless Storm.
audit.corrected: Public Execution 130/115/100s, Lacerate 13/12/11/10/9s, Repudiation 18/17/16/15/14s, Cunning Sweep 14/13/12/11/10s and Stormbringer 160/135/110s written into the spikes, mid, late and the phase whys. focus.text and dosFull[0].t renamed to Public Execution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's Q was called a 'flip' throughout the content layer, and Ambessa's Q was described as a 'ricochet'.
audit.why: Thundering Smash speeds him toward the enemy and stuns the first one he ATTACKS — the timing is on the attack, not on a flip. Cunning Sweep is a semicircle sweep that transforms into Sundering Slam, a line slam, once it strikes. Public Execution blinks to the FARTHEST enemy in a line and suppresses before the stun.
audit.corrected: Restated in spikes[0], spikes[3], mid, late, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Ambessa has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Her dash chain wins level 2: Drakehound's Step off any cast gives her a free attack before your Frenzied Maul re-bites.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Ambessa under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Level 3 is hers — Lacerate (13s) plus the passive dash lets her strike twice, and Repudiation shields the damage you trade back.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Ambessa down every time Repeating Dashes is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul ranks make the second bite chunk. Run her down whenever Lacerate and Repudiation are both spent — that is your clean window.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Ambessa to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Her first item restores tempo: Public Execution (130s) suppresses, so she re-engages after your pattern is already spent.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Ambessa can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: Two items in, her dash chain and Public Execution let her pick the fight. Hold Stormbringer for her R commit instead of opening the trade with it.

edits.before: Level 6 favours you — your R sustain and attack speed beat her burst window.
edits.after: Level 6 favours you — Stormbringer's bonus health beats her burst window.

edits.before: Ambessa's dashes and W chain out-trade you early; her Q ricochet and E dash-slash chunk you before your W ramps, so respect her combo until level 4.
edits.after: Cunning Sweep (14s) transforms into Sundering Slam once it strikes you, and Repudiation shields her while she braces — respect the chain until 4.

edits.before: Your R is the great equalizer — the attack speed and health let you Q-flip through her dashes and out-sustain her burst, so this is your window.
edits.after: Stormbringer (160s) is the equalizer — the bonus health and its tower disable turn a level-6 dive in while Public Execution is still down.

edits.before: Her Eclipse/Profane spike restores her tempo — her R gap-close plus W chain re-engages after you think the trade's over, so don't overstay.
edits.after: Her first item restores tempo — Public Execution (130s) plus the Lacerate dash re-engages after you think the trade is over, so don't overstay.

edits.before: Ambessa scales as a relentless diver; her multiple dashes and R let her stick and reset, so hold your flip for her R commit rather than opening with it.
edits.after: Ambessa scales as a relentless diver; the passive dash off every cast lets her stick, so hold Thundering Smash for her Public Execution, not the opener.

edits.before: Level 4 is your swing point: once your basics online you can Q-flip through her dashes and W-proc her down, and at 6 your R sustain and attack speed shrug off her burst. All-in in this window while her R is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 4 is your swing point: Thundering Smash stuns on the attack, so close the gap first and Frenzied Maul twice on the same mark for the heal. At 6 Stormbringer's bonus health shrugs off her burst — all-in while Public Execution is down.

edits.before: After her first item she reclaims tempo — her R gap-close and dash chain re-engage after your combo, so she out-duels you if you commit early. Hold your Q-flip for her R engage and answer with your own ult; opening blind loses.
edits.after: After her first item she reclaims tempo — Public Execution (130s) blinks to the farthest target in a line and suppresses, so she re-engages after your combo. Hold Thundering Smash for that commit and answer with Stormbringer; opening blind loses.

edits.before: Q-flip her mid-dash to cancel her chain follow-up
edits.after: Stun her mid-chain to cut the follow-up strike

edits.before: Use her mobility to dodge your single Q flip
edits.after: Dodge your one stun with the Drakehound dash

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is a fabricated ability name and it is threaded through tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, ahead, breakdown.* and most report[] entries as well. I renamed focus.text and dosFull[0].t here; the remaining ~20 occurrences are the same substitution and would be safer done by a scripted rename than by hand-matching each before-string. Ambessa's R carries a 'heal' derived flag but Riot's text describes only blink, suppress, slam, damage and stun — I asserted no healing.
